explanation.headline: FDA's records show hydroxocobalamin shortage listed since 2024-11-04 with no signal at our plants

sentences.text: FDA first posted the hydroxocobalamin shortage on 2024-11-04 and it has remained on the list for 24 months as of 2026-10-21.

Our supply at both Corvale East and Corvale General carries NDC 00591288830 labeled by Actavis Pharma, Inc. with the product label naming Hikma Farmaceutica (Portugal) S.A. as the manufacturing plant.
No FDA signal has been posted for the Hikma Farmaceutica (Portugal) S.A. plant associated with our supply.
Corvale East has 5 days on hand while Corvale General has 19 days on hand.
The best option by rule is to transfer 19 units from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would bring Corvale East to 10 days on hand while Corvale General maintains two weeks of supply.

rejected.text: The shortage lists BTG International Inc. and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. as current with estimated recovery for Teva in mid-November 2026.

Q-53a8c9.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%hydroxocobalamin%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%hydroxocobalamin%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-323497.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('a3087a39-f218-4f16-a1e7-17c39bb2eb69') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-83e0b2.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%hydroxocobalamin%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-e88f48.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%hydroxocobalamin%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-c9c437.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%hydroxocobalamin%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-2a4ea9.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3002807504') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-498bf4.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3002807504') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-482d62.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('hikma farmaceutica s a 2705 906 terrugem snt')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-00231c.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('hikma farmaceutica s a 2705 906 terrugem snt', 'actavis') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%hydroxocobalamin%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-ab7761.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00591288830')

Q-80bdd8.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%hydroxocobalamin%'
